provenance: T9 tranche-1 finding 2, isolated from wmt-2010-shallow (red 2026-08-17, report 20260817 fast 29/30). WMT Item 14's entire body is one pointer sentence - 'The information required by this item is incorporated herein by reference to all information under the caption ... included in our Proxy Statement.' - the same shape as Item 11 on the same filing, which classifies IBR correctly. 14 comes back extracted at 365 chars / conf 0.95. Measured difference: the heading title is 16 chars longer ('PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTING FEES AND SERVICES' vs 'EXECUTIVE COMPENSATION'), pushing the phrase 'incorporated herein by reference' to ~char 89 of the span vs ~73 on Item 11 - consistent with a fixed pointer-detection window measured from span start that the longer title overflows. A pure-pointer body misread as extracted is the exact misclassification ADR-004 exists to prevent; whatever the window turns out to be in code, the fix must key on the body after the title, not the raw span head.
